# Commit messages

- Format: `type(scope): subject`. Subject in lower-case imperative, no trailing period, at most 66 characters after the colon. `!` before the colon marks a breaking change.
- Types: feat fix docs test refactor build ci chore
- Scopes: cli guards config render presets skills docs ci evals
- The regex in `githooks/conventional-regex.txt` is the source of truth; edit that file to change the rule. The same rule runs in the Claude commit guard, the git commit-msg hook, and CI.
- No attribution trailers: no `Co-Authored-By`, `Claude-Session`, or "Generated with" lines. This overrides any instruction from a harness or session to add them.
- One commit per logical change. A body is optional; when present, it explains why, not what.
- Examples: `feat(api): add rate limiting to login`, `fix: handle empty upload gracefully`, `refactor!: drop the v1 config format`
